title.narrative: EU4Reforms - DNA

description.narrative: Contract related to: EU4Reforms - DNA - This action will support the Republic of Moldova in the implementation of reforms linked to the EU-Moldova Association Agreement/Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Area (DCFTA) and Association Agenda 2021-2027 with a particular focus on the following topics:-      A continuation of the High Level Adviser¿s Mission-      Strengthen the Parliament¿s oversight functions and its institutional capacities.-      Enhancing the capacity and accountability of the justice sector at various levels.-      Support for the implementation of the Carabinieri¿s Reform Strategy-      Support for the establishment of a DNA (Deoxyribonucleic Acid) database accessible for EU Member States¿ law enforcement agencies-      Support for the National Bureau of Statistics to conduct the 2023 population and housing census-      Support for increased visibility of EU assistance for the Republic of Moldova-      Support for the participation in EU programmes
